Name: MAP_PATTERN_MAP_LOT_CONDITION_ST
Description: Conditions that filter map patterns for a mission: a matching target Nightlord passes at once; otherwise the required modifier must be active and the excluded modifiers inactive. Can also force an extra major site.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Set: the row is left out of the network test build. Retail: set on 4 rows.

Fields.Name: Required Modifier
Fields.Description: The condition only passes if the map pattern has this modifier (e.g. 11 Mountaintop, 13 Rotted Woods, 140). 0: no requirement. Ignored when Target Nightlord 1 or 2 matches.

Fields.Name: Excluded Modifier 1
Fields.Description: The condition fails if the map pattern has this modifier (e.g. 13, 15, 419). 0: none. Ignored when Target Nightlord 1 or 2 matches.

Fields.Name: Forced Invader
Fields.Description: SmallbaseInvationNpcParam row that fills the first invader slot of the pattern when this row applies, before the weighted invader draw (its Lot Weight is ignored). -1: none; 0 points at the blank row (no invader). Retail: 100, 200 and 300 (Night Assassin, Night Fallen, Night Hunter) on the Mountaintop, Crater and Rotted Woods rows.

Fields.Name: Force an Extra Major Site
Fields.Description: Set: when this row applies, the pattern gets at least one extra major site even if MapPatternSet's weighted draw gives none. Retail: set on the Mountaintop, Crater and Rotted Woods rows.

Fields.Name: Target Nightlord 1
Fields.Description: The condition passes, whatever the modifiers, when the expedition's Nightlord is this one: 0 Gladius, 1 Adel, 2 Gnoster, 3 Maris, 4 Libra, 5 Fulghor, 6 Caligo, 7 Heolstor, 8 Harmonia, 9 Straghess. -1: unused.

Fields.Name: Target Nightlord 2
Fields.Description: Second Nightlord that passes the condition, as Target Nightlord 1. -1: unused.

Fields.Name: Unknown
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail 0 on every row.

Fields.Name: Excluded Invader
Fields.Description: SmallbaseInvationNpcParam row that cannot be an invader in the pattern when this row applies: it is skipped by the weighted draw and dropped from the forced invaders. -1: none. Retail: 300 (Night Hunter) on Ironeye's personal scenario mission 2.

Fields.Name: Excluded Modifier 2
Fields.Description: The condition fails if the map pattern has this modifier, as Excluded Modifier 1. 0: none. Retail: 14 (Great Hollow) on seven personal-scenario rows.
